area_formacao_outro.computacao: Computer Science, Information Systems, and Software-Focused Engineering (Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, Networking)
area_formacao_outro.autodidata: Self-taught (no formal education in the field)

situacao_outro.atuacao_industria_integral: I work full-time at a game industry company
situacao_outro.atuacao_industria_parcial: I work part-time at a game industry company
situacao_outro.atuacao_freelancer: I develop games as a freelancer/contractor regularly
situacao_outro.atuacao_indie_horas_vagas: I develop independent games in my spare time (hobbyist/unpaid or occasional revenue)
situacao_outro.atuacao_eventual: I develop games occasionally, in one-off or collaborative projects (e.g., Game Jams)
situacao_outro.atuacao_indie_fulltime: I work full-time at a game industry independently
situacao_outro.ja_atuou_na_industria: I worked full-time at a game industry company
situacao_outro.atuacao_industria_educativa: I develop games as part of academic or educational activities
situacao_outro.atuacao_industria_adjacente: I do not develop games, only follow industry news and consumption trends
I work full-time at a adjacent game industry company

situacao_equipe_outro.pequena: In a Small Team (2 to 15 people)
situacao_equipe_outro.media: In a Medium Team (15 to 60 people)
situacao_equipe_outro.grande: In a Large Team (60 to 120 people)
situacao_equipe_outro.muito_grande: In a Very Large Team (120+ people)
situacao_equipe_outro.varia: It varies quite a bit from project to project
situacao_equipe_outro.nao_participa: I work independently and do not have direct contact with the project team

ferramentas_desenvolvimento_outro.propria_corporativa: Custom Engine (Proprietary, made by the company)
ferramentas_desenvolvimento_outro.nada: I do not use game engines (programming with basic libs like SDL)
ferramentas_desenvolvimento_outro.outras_engines: Other Game Engines (Construct, GDevelop, Defold, Ren'Py, Cryengine, etc.)

dificuldades_manutencao_outro.codigo_dificil: Code becomes difficult to understand over time
dificuldades_manutencao_outro.mudancas_quebram: Making changes causes unexpected errors in other parts of the game (regressions)
dificuldades_manutencao_outro.prazo_curto: Lack of time or tight deadlines
dificuldades_manutencao_outro.mudancas_escopo: Changes in scope or features in the middle of the project
dificuldades_manutencao_outro.sem_boas_praticas: Absence of good software engineering practices
dificuldades_manutencao_outro.sem_dificuldades: I do not face significant difficulties in this aspect
dificuldades_manutencao_outro.limitacoes_tecnologia: Technology, engine, framework, and tool limitations

testes_jogo_outro.exploratorio: Exploratory testing — I play freely and observe if there are glitches or strange behaviors
testes_jogo_outro.roteiro: Scripted testing — I follow a list of steps or a checklist to verify specific features
testes_jogo_outro.automatizado: Automated testing — I use tools or scripts to test parts of the game without manual intervention
testes_jogo_outro.agentes: Simulated agents — I use bots or scripts that mimic player behavior to test the game

dificuldades_testes_outro.entendimento_frameworks: Difficulty understanding how testing tools work.
dificuldades_testes_outro.integracao_dificil: Complication integrating tests into the project workflow.
dificuldades_testes_outro.preferencia_humanos: The feeling that manual tests are more practical or efficient.
dificuldades_testes_outro.criacao_dificil: Difficult to develop and keep the tests up-to-date.
dificuldades_testes_outro.nao_encontram_erros_reais: Perception that automated tests do not find the "bugs that matter".
dificuldades_testes_outro.nunca_usei: I have never tried using automated tests.
dificuldades_testes_outro.falta_tempo_prazo: Lack of time, strict deadlines, or unfavorable cost-benefit ratio.
dificuldades_testes_outro.elementos_subjetivos: Difficulty testing subjective elements ("game feel", player experience) or non-deterministic gameplay.
dificuldades_testes_outro.limitacoes_tecnicas_engine: Technical limitations of the game engine, architecture, or visual scripting (e.g., Unity, Blueprints).
dificuldades_testes_outro.limitacoes_equipe: Team limitations (difficulty training team members or getting them on board).

ferramentas_teste_outro.godot_tests: A Godot Test Framework Plugin (e.g., GUT or gdUnit)
ferramentas_teste_outro.nenhuma: I have never used automated testing tools
ferramentas_teste_outro.ferramentas_proprias_bots: Custom, In-house, or Proprietary Testing Tools (including custom bots)
ferramentas_teste_outro.frameworks_gerais_software: General Software Testing Frameworks (NUnit, Jest, Pytest, Rust/C++ units, Playwright, etc.)
ferramentas_teste_outro.ci_cd_devops: CI/CD and DevOps Automation Tools (GitHub Actions, TeamCity, SonarQube, etc.)

conteudo_testado_outro.componentes: Isolated components — I verify if specific parts of the code work correctly independently (Unit Testing)
conteudo_testado_outro.performance: Basic performance — I evaluate load times, frame rate (FPS), or resource consumption
conteudo_testado_outro.cenarios: Specific game scenarios — I simulate gameplay situations to check if the game responds as expected
conteudo_testado_outro.teste_fumaca: Smoke tests — I only check if the game starts and runs without critical crashes
conteudo_testado_outro.simulacao: Simulation — I simulate a player's behavior through an agent
conteudo_testado_outro.nao_uso: I do not use automated tests
conteudo_testado_outro.integracao_e2e: Integration and End-to-End (E2E) Testing — I test how multiple components, sub-systems, or features work together.
conteudo_testado_outro.backend_servicos_externos: Backend, Server, and External Services — I test APIs, databases, server logic, or network services outside the game client.

tipo_falha_outro.stuck: Stuck — player gets stuck without being able to exit (Softlock)
tipo_falha_outro.crash: Crash — game closes, freezes, or hangs
tipo_falha_outro.visual_multimidia: Visual glitches or strange audio noises
tipo_falha_outro.balanceamento: Game balance outside the planned level (too easy, too hard, or inconsistent)
tipo_falha_outro.infraestrutura_rede_sync: Networking, Sync, Backend, and Infrastructure Issues (e.g., replication, server downtime, security)
tipo_falha_outro.falhas_design_gameplay_chato: Core Design Flaws, Boring Gameplay Loops, or Lack of Player Engagement
tipo_falha_outro.nao_se_aplica: Not Applicable (e.g., out-of-scope roles, meta-responses, personal motivation)

etapa_testes_outro.antes_funcionalidade: Before implementing the feature — I follow a test-driven approach (Test-Driven Development)
etapa_testes_outro.durante_funcionalidade: During or right after implementing the feature — I write tests along with the code
etapa_testes_outro.pos_prototipo: After creating a functional prototype — I test when I already have something playable or testable
etapa_testes_outro.final: Only at the end of the project, during the review phase
etapa_testes_outro.nunca: I do not use automated tests
etapa_testes_outro.quando_possivel: When there is time or opportunity — without a defined step in the process
etapa_testes_outro.depende_sistema_hibrido: It depends on the project/system, or I use a hybrid approach (combination of phases)
etapa_testes_outro.nao_sei_nao_responsavel: I do not know, or I am not the person responsible for implementing tests
etapa_testes_outro.critica_pesquisa_fora_escopo: Invalid response, critique of the survey, or out of scope

requisito_testes_outro.atualizacao: To accept contributions from collaborators (e.g., pull requests)
requisito_testes_outro.proxima_fase: To allow the project to advance to the next phase (alpha, beta)
requisito_testes_outro.nova_funcionalidade: To start the development of a new feature
requisito_testes_outro.nunca: They are not a mandatory requirement in projects

avaliacao_artefatos_outro.criterios_definidos: I use previously defined criteria (e.g., style, clarity, audience suitability)
avaliacao_artefatos_outro.avaliacao_subjetiva: I rely on informal or subjective evaluation, without a structured evaluation process
avaliacao_artefatos_outro.testes_formais: I perform formal tests with users or specific tools
avaliacao_artefatos_outro.avaliacao_por_outros: The evaluation is done mainly by other people on the team
avaliacao_artefatos_outro.feedback_externo_informal: Informal external feedback (e.g., sharing with friends, online communities like Reddit)

design_validacao_outro.prototipo_simplificado: Through simplified playable prototypes (digital or analog)
design_validacao_outro.prototipo_real: With physical or real-world simulations (e.g., with people, objects, role-playing)
design_validacao_outro.excel: Using spreadsheets to simulate systems or balancing
design_validacao_outro.mental: I mentally simulate scenarios and interactions
design_validacao_outro.nenhum: I usually implement directly without prior design validation.
design_validacao_outro.documentos_mapas_diagramas: Writing documents, mind maps, diagrams, or narrative explorations
design_validacao_outro.reunioes_feedback_equipe: Discussions, meetings, or feedback from team members and clients

areas_uso_ia_outro.ideias_criativas: To generate creative ideas (e.g., characters, mechanics, narratives, dialogues)
areas_uso_ia_outro.conteudo_visual_sonoro: To create visual or audio content (e.g., concept art, voices, soundtracks, effects)
areas_uso_ia_outro.implementacao: To assist in implementation (e.g., writing or reviewing code, suggesting technical solutions)
areas_uso_ia_outro.planejamento: To plan or structure the game (e.g., documentation, system architecture, balancing)
areas_uso_ia_outro.testes: To create or suggest automated tests (e.g., generating test cases, validation scripts)
areas_uso_ia_outro.validacao: To review or validate game features (e.g., finding bugs, checking logic)
areas_uso_ia_outro.ainda_nao_usei: I haven't used AI yet, but I am curious or interested
areas_uso_ia_outro.nao_usarei: I do not use AI in my game projects and do not intend to.
areas_uso_ia_outro.pesquisa_documentacao_aprendizado: Research, Learning, and Understanding Documentation (e.g., advanced search, explaining code, math)
areas_uso_ia_outro.prototipagem_placeholders_ferramentas: Prototyping, Tooling, and Placeholders (e.g., quick scripts, temporary programmer art)
areas_uso_ia_outro.refinamento_texto_localizacao: Text Refinement and Localization (e.g., spellchecking, translation, thesaurus)

percepcao_uso_ia_outro.etica_dados: Unauthorized use of data and ethical issues (copyright, authorship, credits, plagiarism)
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.privacidade: Privacy concerns: my inputs might be reused without control
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.substituicao: Fear that professionals in the field will be replaced by AI
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.confiabilidade_transparencia: Lack of transparency and difficulty verifying the originality or reliability of what AI produces
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.etica: Ethics in AI use (e.g., authorship, credits, plagiarism)
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.sem_preocupacoes: I have no significant concerns at the moment
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.sem_qualidade: Low quality output, technical debt, bugs, and increased review time (e.g., 'AI Slop')
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.perda_de_habilidade: Loss of human skills, cognitive debt, and over-reliance on AI
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.perda_visao_artistica: Loss of artistic intent, lack of originality, and poor creative control
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.impacto_ambiental: Environmental and ecological impacts (e.g., power consumption)
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.seguranca_vulnerabilidade: Security vulnerabilities and safety risks of AI agents
percepcao_uso_ia_outro.reputacao_opiniao_publica: Negative public perception and potential reputation damage

consideracoes_finais.prefer_manal: 1. Preference for manual testing & human playtesting (self, friends, team, or community)
consideracoes_finais.scope: 2. Scope & resource constraints (solo developers, small teams, short cycles, or game jams)
consideracoes_finais.no_time: 3. Time, budget, or delivery constraints (rushed timelines leave no room for testing)
consideracoes_finais.hight_cost: 4. High cost-of-maintenance & fragility of automated tests (frequent code/UI/gameplay changes)
consideracoes_finais.autotests_dont_work: 5. Games as a subjective/artistic medium (untestable 'feel', focus on fun, TDD doesn't fit gameplay)
consideracoes_finais.standard_too_hard: 6. Technical difficulty of testing in standard engines (Unity/Unreal limitations, mocking complexities)
consideracoes_finais.i_test_and_use_cicd: 7. Successful, active use, or practical implementation of automated testing/CI-CD pipelines
consideracoes_finais.curius_about_automatd_testeing_and_ia: 8. Curiosity, optimism, or interest in adopting automated testing (including AI agent testing)
consideracoes_finais.opinions_on_ai: 9. Opinions on Generative AI (Ethical concerns, 'slop', anti-AI policies, or positive productivity tool)
consideracoes_finais.critic_on_software_engeniring: 10. Critique of software engineering dogmas/buzzwords (SOLID, Clean Code, TDD as mindless overhead)
consideracoes_finais.feedback_on_survey: 11. Meta-feedback on the survey, personal backgrounds, or industry rants
